facility.name: Loving Care Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2822 TOYAH AVE, HOUSTON, TX, 77039

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored: There was an infant swing on the toddler playground observed to be unstable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored (26 TAC §746.4601(5))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): The rotating structure on the infant toddler playground does not have a use zone of at least 6-feet from perimeter.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings  - No Overlap: The swings use zone is overlapping with a rotating structure's use zone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings  - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4807(b))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Both playgrounds were observed with no loose-fill or unitary surfacing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions: Booster seats are not being used when transporting children ages 4-6 years old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child in Appropriate System According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5607(c))

occurrences.finding: Safety-Hinged Lid Storage Containers Safe: An Un-Hinged Lid Storage was observed outside accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Multiple Occupancy Swings: A 4-seater teeter totter was observed on the Toddler playground, and a two-seater teeter totter was observed on the pre-K and school-age playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Multiple Occupancy Swings (26 TAC §746.4603(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: Based on the information available during the investigation inspection, sufficient evidence was available to support the facility did not have a menu posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, the driver who transported a group of children to school, failed to develop proper seating arrangements for a child who is a known sleeper while being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, the driver who transported a group of children, failed to ensure all of the children who loaded the vehicle were properly unloaded.  Note: The driver deviated from their normal route to pick-up/drop-off another group of children, as a result, the driver was unaware a child was sleeping on the seat of the vehicle and had not been dropped off at school until the child's elementary school inquired about the child's absence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, sufficient evidence available to support the driver who transported a group of children did not have a checklist which included the names of all children that had been transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: During the follow-up inspection, a five month old was observed sleeping in a bouncer.  The caregiver stated the child had been sleeping 10-15 minutes.  The caregiver also stated the child had recently finished a bottle and she had to change the sheets on the infant's crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Written feeding instructions for five infants had not been updated within 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat: One infant was observed sleeping on a baby boppy on the floor with cover.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: A 5 month old infant was observed to be sleep in a baby bouncer with a blanket over them
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The fire inspection available for review was last conducted on 08/22/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A safe sleep exemption form was not available for review for a 5-month-old infant observed to be placed on their stomach while the caregiver was patting their back to put them to sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Must Place Infants in Face up Sleeping Position or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Four infants under 12-months old were observed with blankets in their crib.  Note:  Three of the infants were sleep and covered with the blanket and the 4th was being put to sleep with the blanket observed in the corner of their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Documentation was not available for review to support a caregiver's high school graduation from outside of the United States.    Out of the five records for staff evaluated during the inspection, one did not complete their required training by 05/20/2023 (missing 14 clock hours); three newly hired caregivers w/o previous experience, did not completed 8 hours of training before being in the classroom.  Hire dates 08/14/2023, 08/21/2023 and 08/23/2023; one caregiver who supervises children under 24 months did not have verification they completed Sids/Shaken Baby and Brain Development Training.  The director had completed 30 clock hours of their annual training on/before 07/29/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: A boppy pillow recalled 9/23/21 was observed to be in the infant room and in use by an infant in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: Two infants were observed sleeping in their cribs without the sheets being tight fitting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Products Safety certification was last completed 10/2018
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The current gas inspection available for review was conducted 03/16/2020
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information obtained, it is determined that there is evidence to support that the the operation failed to report the incident placing a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
